title: AC1027 classic POLYLINE compound LTYPE XDATA target transport

scope.source: Runtime-generated ASCII and binary DXF records; no repository fixture file was added.
scope.cross_product: One classic 2D POLYLINE compound target in model-space ENTITIES and named AuthorityBlock BLOCKS, across all four source/output encoding pairs.
scope.linetype: Source-bound simple LTYPE with the existing MLINE_LTYPE_XDATA APPID provider.

xdata.payload: One ordered group-1005 soft-pointer to source handle 0xA900.

references.target: model-space POLYLINE or named-block POLYLINE, selected per profile

targets.fields: Same selected classic 2D POLYLINE root, ordered VERTEX chain and SEQEND profile as the model-space target.

proof.source: Physical source records bind the code-1005 reference to the exact POLYLINE root. The compound audit binds its callback, contiguous three-VERTEX sequence, child identities and root ownership, and SEQEND identity/ownership. Typed import checks exact DRW_Polyline, DRW_Vertex and DRW_SeqEnd types and selected root/child fields.
proof.output: For each ASCII/binary source/output pair, physical output checks the remapped root/child/footer handles, section, owner chain, subclass, root widths/elevation/thickness/flags, ordered vertex geometry/widths/bulges/identifiers, and remapped group-1005 reference. Canonical output omits default vertex group 70 value 0; fresh typed readback verifies its unchanged zero meaning and all selected fields.
proof.failure_retry: Removing the target independently refuses export and preserves the existing destination, then succeeds on same-adapter retry for all eight placement/encoding profiles. A separate late-handle mutation refuses without replacing the destination and succeeds after source identity restoration.

focused_ctest.result: PASS (1/1, 24.97 seconds); selector asserts the whole-test counts above

limits: This qualifies one AC1027 classic 2D POLYLINE profile with three 2D vertices and one SEQEND in model-space ENTITIES and named AuthorityBlock BLOCKS, for the authored ASCII/binary source/output combinations. Other POLYLINE subtypes, flags, vertex counts, versions, target pairings and XDATA compositions remain open.
The source classifier now recognizes group 39 thickness in the common AcDbEntity portion before the POLYLINE subclass; this does not qualify other entity-specific common-field profiles.

This is selected identity, owner, field transport, output/readback and transaction evidence. It does not establish polyline rendering, independent CAD semantics, recursive document closure or any general DWG/DXF support claim.
next: Select a bounded remaining code-1005 target profile with a distinctive current source/parser/output gap; keep selected transport evidence separate from native semantics and document closure.
